title: Quarterly Runway: Cross-Functional Prioritization Lattice for Hosted API & Model Fleet
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Purpose: Create a repeatable, cross-functional quarterly planning artifact (the 'Runway Lattice') that connects company OKRs, product initiatives, engineering capacity, and model catalog actions into one lane-by-lane prioritization map for Hosted API and the model fleet.

Scope:
- Define prioritization axes (revenue impact, latency/cost delta, reliability risk, regulatory/sensitivity).
- For each hosted API capability (generation, embeddings, reranking, streaming), map candidate model variants and catalog actions (additions, deprecations, quantization, variant gating).
- Produce a runway with recommended tranches (must-have, high-value, exploratory) and clear gating criteria for canary, A/B, and rollout.
- Output artifacts: one-page executive runway, a deliverable backlog for Eng/Design, and the operational rollout checklist for Console/Dedicated/Private.

Deliverables & Acceptance Criteria: 
- Runway Lattice visual (one-pager) that stakeholders can read in < 5 minutes and that ties to OKRs.
- Prioritized backlog with estimated engineering points and required design/infra work.
- Release gating rubric (metrics, safety checks, fallback model paths).
- Playbook for synchronizing model catalog updates with Hosted API release windows.
- Stakeholder sign-off from Eng, Design, Security, and Sales.

Success metrics: 
- 90% of roadmap items have explicit gating criteria and rollout plan by release cut.
- Reduction in cross-team alignment meetings by 30% during quarterly planning.
- No unplanned model rollback incidents caused by catalog mismatch in the following quarter.

Key stakeholders: 
- PM lead: Priya Nair
- Eng lead: Liam Chen
- Design: Ava Martinez
- Security/Compliance: Jordan Brooks
- Solutions & Sales liaison: Maria Ortega

Timeline & Milestones: 
- Feb 15: Kickoff + initial candidate list (done).
- Feb 22: Cross-functional scoring workshop (in progress).
- Mar 01: Draft runway lattice + backlog (target - this ticket's updated_at).
- Mar 10: Stakeholder review + iterate.
- Mar 20: Finalize gating rubric and publish playbook.
- Mar 31: Roadmap commit for the quarter (release schedule windows locked).

Risks & Mitigations: 
- Risk: Conflicting signals between revenue-driven prioritization and reliability-first model gating. Mitigation: dual-path tranches with mandatory reliability escrow for high-revenue items.
- Risk: Catalog churn around quantized variants increases test surface area. Mitigation: require a preflight compatibility matrix and test harness entry in backlog.
- Risk: Dependencies on Dedicated capacity quotas. Mitigation: early capacity reservation requests and fallback model routing policy in the playbook.

Open questions: 
- Should embargoed model variants (security-sensitive) be placed in a separate runway lane for private deployments?
- What minimal telemetry thresholds must be met for a canary to graduate?
- How do we weight short-term revenue vs. long-term infra savings in a repeatable formula?

References & Links: 
- Draft scoring rubric doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pm/runway-lattice-draft
- Hosted API catalog staging sheet: https://drive.redwood.ai/hosted-model-catalog/staging
- Example rollout checklist (runtime): https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/model-rollout-checklist

Notes on scope control: This ticket is product-facing and focuses on the planning artifact and backlog orchestration. Work to implement model changes, new infra, or Console features will be created as child engineering and design tickets once the lattice is committed.
